description: The results page -- opportunity matrix, tag summary, case studies, and every caveat this project's whole methodology depends on being visible. Addressed by query parameter, not session state, so it is refresh-safe and linkable (07_ui.module_spec.json's own design note).
signature: def render_analysis_detail_page(conn: sqlite3.Connection, settings: Settings) -> None
docstring:
Render one run's results.

Args:
    conn: This page's own short-lived connection.
    settings: Unused directly here beyond what reporting/storage need, kept for signature consistency with the other two page functions.

Behavior:
    - run_id = st.query_params.get('run_id'); if missing or unknown (reporting.ReportNotAvailable), render a friendly empty state with a link back to Past Analyses, never a traceback.
    - report = reporting.load_run_report(conn, run_id) -- called exactly once per rerun of this page.
    - render_caveat_panel(report.caveats) is rendered near the top, before any figure, and again is implicitly required alongside every revenue/complexity-showing section per the module's own invariant ('every surface showing a sales, revenue or complexity figure also renders the caveat panel') -- in practice this means the panel appears once at the top of this page, since the whole page is one such surface.
    - If report.is_partial: render reporting.partial_run_caveat(report.missing_stages, report.run) prominently above the results, and additionally render_progress_panel(settings.db_path, run_id) if report.run.status == 'running' (a still-live run can be watched from its own detail page, not only from the page that started it).
    - Render report.opportunity_matrix, report.tag_summary, report.tag_trends, report.case_studies (each case study showing its rationale and complexity_drivers), and report.funnel (making the coarse-filter boundary from ARCHITECTURE.md limitation 7 visible, per the module's own design intent).
    - Empty-but-legitimate results (report.funnel.candidate_count == 0, or too few games to cluster) render an explicit 'not enough data' message in place of a chart, never a blank or broken chart.
postconditions: load_run_report is called at most once per rerun of this page
partial_run_caveat is rendered whenever report.is_partial is True, and never when it is False
render_caveat_panel is rendered before any revenue or complexity figure on this page

edge_cases.expected_behavior: empty state with a link to Past Analyses, no exception, no call to load_run_report
same empty state, caught explicitly around the load_run_report call
partial_run_caveat AND the live progress panel both render -- the user can watch it finish from the detail page itself, not just the page that started it
partial_run_caveat renders with the error message; no progress panel (nothing is live to watch)
an explicit 'not enough data' message in place of the opportunity matrix / tag summary charts, never an empty chart rendered as if there were simply zero rows to plot

edge_cases.input: An older run whose schema predates a newly added field
edge_cases.expected_behavior: the missing field renders as an explicit unavailable marker, per reporting's own schema-evolution edge case -- this page must not assume every RunReport field is always present with a real value

unit_tests.name: test_unknown_run_id_shows_empty_state
unit_tests.description: An unknown run_id in query_params renders the empty state, no exception.
unit_tests.expected: no exception; empty-state text and a link rendered

unit_tests.name: test_partial_report_renders_caveat_and_missing_stages
unit_tests.description: A partial (is_partial=True) fixture report renders partial_run_caveat naming report.missing_stages.
unit_tests.expected: caveat rendered; missing stage names appear in output

unit_tests.name: test_running_partial_report_shows_progress_panel_too
unit_tests.description: A running, partial report additionally renders the progress panel.

unit_tests.name: test_failed_partial_report_no_progress_panel
unit_tests.description: A failed, partial report does not render the progress panel.

unit_tests.name: test_complete_report_no_partial_caveat
unit_tests.description: A fully succeeded fixture report never renders partial_run_caveat.

unit_tests.name: test_caveat_panel_always_present
unit_tests.description: render_caveat_panel is called on every render of this page, complete or partial.
unit_tests.expected: called exactly once per page render

unit_tests.name: test_empty_candidate_set_shows_not_enough_data
unit_tests.description: A fixture with funnel.candidate_count == 0 shows the explicit message instead of a chart.
unit_tests.expected: 'not enough data' text present; no chart component rendered for the opportunity matrix
